sections.title: Before booking in Nanaimo
sections.html:
If hair is your main reason for booking, bring a picture of your current colour and a few examples you like. Ask whether the analysis also covers clothing neutrals and makeup, what reference you keep, and whether the hair consultation needs another slot. A palette category should be the beginning of a conversation about the look you want.

  • Is the consultation separate from hair colouring and styling?
  • What palette or written reference will I receive?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: Use a preview to compare broad directions before making a salon decision, then let the stylist assess the real hair and maintenance requirements. For your wardrobe, start with a familiar outfit and one alternative near-face colour. Stylist AI can keep that exploration on your phone while you decide whether hands-on guidance would be helpful.
